name: Neck and Shoulders, Seated
description: Six slow, seated moves for the neck and shoulders, with short rests between them.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A short seated routine for your neck and shoulders, shown on Movement Routine.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Do one move or all six.
howToPlay: Sit comfortably and read the move.
Press Start timer for timed moves, or take your time with moves counted in times.
Press Next when you are ready for the following move, or Skip to leave one out.
tips: General ideas for a break, not advice. Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip any that do not suit you.
